objective: Add a small reusable Qt image-preview component that safely presents a local image with bounded aspect-ratio scaling and explicit empty or unreadable states, without invoking inference.
acceptance_criteria: A focused GUI component accepts a local image path, decodes it through supported Qt image APIs, applies orientation metadata where supported, and displays the image without starting inference or loading model artifacts.
The displayed pixmap preserves aspect ratio and is bounded by a documented preview size so large source images do not expand the page layout to their native dimensions.
The initial and cleared states use an explicit neutral placeholder, and a missing, non-file, unsupported, or corrupt input produces a concise unavailable state without raising into the Qt event loop.
Loading a valid image after an invalid image and clearing after a valid image remove stale pixmap and stale error state deterministically.
The component does not mutate the source file, perform network access, use CUDA, cache decoded images outside widget ownership, or add a dependency.
Qt tests create only local temporary images and inspect widget state and pixmap dimensions programmatically without screenshots, arbitrary sleeps, or timing races.
Existing assertions are not removed or weakened, and no Git operation is performed.
claude_prompt: Implement Phase 13 CP1 only in src/image_ai_studio/gui/image_preview.py and tests/gui/test_image_preview.py. Create a minimal reusable PySide6 image-preview component for local files with a neutral empty state, concise invalid/unreadable state, orientation-aware Qt decoding where available, bounded aspect-ratio-preserving display, and deterministic clear/reload behavior. It must not run inference, touch model artifacts, mutate inputs, access network/CUDA, add dependencies, cache global image state, use screenshots, or rely on sleeps. Tests must use tmp_path and qtbot, verify text/pixmap state and dimensions programmatically, retain strong assertions, and introduce no unregistered pytest marker. Do not modify any other file, run Git commands, commit, or push.
estimated_scope: Small isolated Qt component and focused tests, approximately 180-300 changed lines across two new files.
